definitions.gloss: interception; intercepting attack; counterattack against an approaching enemy
definitions.explanation: A military or defensive action to intercept and engage incoming enemies, missiles, or aircraft before they reach their target.

examples.japanese: ミサイルを{迎撃|げいげき}する。
{迎撃|げいげき}システムが{配備|はいび}された。
{敵|てき}の{攻撃|こうげき}を{迎撃|げいげき}するために{戦闘機|せんとうき}がスクランブル{発進|はっしん}した。
examples.english: Fighter jets scrambled to intercept the enemy attack.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a suru verb ({迎撃|げいげき}する). Common in military and defense contexts, and frequently appears in news about missile defense systems.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迎撃|げいげき}ミサイル (interceptor missile)
- {迎撃|げいげき}システム (interception system)
- {迎撃|げいげき}する (to intercept)
- ミサイル{迎撃|げいげき} (missile interception)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {撃退|げきたい}: repelling, driving back — focuses on forcing retreat
- {防衛|ぼうえい}: defense — broader concept of defense
